source: generalize delta 002 D1. Card: SD Association microSD physical specification, 11.0 x 15.0 x 1.0 mm. Seated protrusion 2.5 mm beyond the slot mouth: the rpi_zero2w catalogue assumption (sd_card_protrusion, push-push slot). ASSUMED, uncertainty medium: the access zone outside the seated card (the 'overmold' role of a plug: card plus fingertip) is 12.0 wide x 5.4 high with its centre 1.0 above the card axis, from the seat outward 8.5 mm (protrusion + a 6.0 mm fingertip); these are the numbers of the rpi_zero2w sd_card_zone keep-out (sd_width x sd_height + 4.0, from pcb_thickness - 1.0), the zone a microSD opening must clear. The name is the card, never the slot: a slot is the receptacle.
frame: plug: origin at the card tip (the end inserted first), centred in Y and Z on the card; the card runs along +X; it is inserted by moving along -X (mating direction = -PLUG_AXIS)

zone_length.source: assumed: the exposed card (2.5) plus a 6.0 mm fingertip, from the seat outward

zone_width.source: assumed: fingertip access width, the slot cage width (rpi_zero2w sd_width)
